answer: Think of the agent economy as sable sand where every grain looks the same until you dig. Each epoch, every agent faces a fresh capability exam — a reasoning task that cannot be memorized. First, it is issued at a random minute, so fakes cannot queue answers. Second, it must be solved within ten minutes. Third, two failures in a row lock the identity for a week. Fourth, passing scores stack into a public record, a pulse of honest work rising to the zenith. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $4,000 and 1,667 GPU-hours. A sybil swarm is a sable dune at noon: golden from afar, gone when you grab it.
